label: Product Quantization (PQ)
type: a vector compression method that splits each vector into subvectors and quantizes each independently
note: Promoted with vector-search:scalar-quantization as a two-member closed family - see that record for the family-exception reasoning. Support is index-type-dependent and stated as such: 'Hyperscale Vector and Composite Vector indexes support PQ quantization. Search Vector Indexes do not support it.'
recurrence_note: Round 15 corrected this from 2 to 1, and corrected this record's own quotation.
